ios.desc:
Love using AI chatbots but have privacy concerns? Does training on your data not sit right? MyDeviceAI is for you. The only free and open source AI app that gives you complete privacy with capability close to what other AI chatbots provide. 100% free. Your data stays private and on your device. You get the answers you need from AI, fast.

Here's what makes MyDeviceAI stand out:

Seamless Experience: MyDeviceAI comes with bundled AI models that load asynchronously in the background, ensuring zero waiting time from the moment you launch. No pausing for initialization, just open and go.

Remote Desktop Connection: Connect your phone to your desktop computer using secure peer-to-peer WebRTC connections through MyDeviceAI-Desktop. Access powerful desktop-class AI models directly from your mobile device with automatic retry and reconnection support all while maintaining complete privacy and control. No cloud servers involved.

Web Search Integration: Local AI models are powerful, but they can sometimes miss the vast knowledge of larger models. MyDeviceAI bridges that gap with a self-hosted SearXNG-powered search for great results and complete privacy.

Universal Thinking Support: Tackle complex challenges with Thinking Mode, with universal support across compatible models including Qwen 3.5. Whether you're solving intricate problems or brainstorming ideas, MyDeviceAI helps you reason deeper.

Qwen 3.5 Support: MyDeviceAI now supports Qwen 3.5, bringing improved reasoning and response quality right to your device.

Free and Open Source: Completely free and open source. Check out the code and contribute at github.com/navedmerchant/MyDeviceAI. Built on transparency and community-driven development.

Broad Device Support: Compatible with all modern iPhones. Experience fast response speeds on modern devices, with full support for older models at a slightly slower pace.

Chat History: Access up to 30 days of conversation history, making it easy to reference past discussions and maintain context over time.

Custom Models: Use MyDeviceAI with any GGUF file from HuggingFace. This feature is for advanced users you don't need to know what these models are to use MyDeviceAI. It's designed to be fast and usable out of the box.

Experience the future of AI with MyDeviceAI where privacy meets power. Download now and transform the way you interact with information.

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I built MyDevice AI because I was frustrated with the privacy trade-offs of existing AI chatbots. I wanted the convenience and capability of modern AI without my conversations being sent to remote servers or used for training.
What it is: A completely local AI assistant that runs entirely on your iPhone. Think Perplexity, but your data never leaves your device.
Key features:

100% local processing - All AI inference happens on-device using optimized models
Web search integration - Built-in SearXNG search for up-to-date information while maintaining privacy. Tiny models on phones can hallucinate quite a bit, but web search acts as an anchor point that makes them dramatically smarter and more trustworthy - they stay focused and factual
Lightning fast - Async model loading means no waiting around for initialization
Thinking Mode - Powered by Qwen 3 for complex problem-solving
30+ day chat history - Your conversations are preserved locally
Completely free and open source - No subscriptions, no data collection

Recent updates:

Redesigned UI that's much cleaner
Zero-config SearXNG integration (no more setup headaches)
Image previews in search results
Tons of bug fixes based on user feedback

I've been dogfooding this for months and it's become my primary AI assistant. Response times are impressive on modern iPhones, and knowing my conversations stay private makes all the difference.
